subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw accept skill-authored configuration actions in `SKILL.md` metadata, and what URL trust/action contract should the dashboard expose?
rationale: The requested behavior is plausible but crosses a public skill metadata boundary and turns untrusted or third-party skill text into an actionable dashboard link, so automation should not choose the permanent semantics or security policy.

options.title: Approve a typed config action contract
options.body: Add a structured configuration-action field with strict URL validation, explicit trust labeling, docs, and tests across parser, status payload, and Control UI.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces only
options.body: Decline new fields for now and direct skills to use `homepage`, Skill Cards, ClawHub metadata, or plugin-owned settings until a broader settings surface exists.

options.title: Defer for broader plugin settings design
options.body: Keep this issue open as part of a larger plugin/skill settings design instead of adding `configUrl` and `configButton` independently.

recommendation.title: Approve a typed config action contract
recommendation.body: Add a structured configuration-action field with strict URL validation, explicit trust labeling, docs, and tests across parser, status payload, and Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current dashboard/skill-surface snapshot and has adjacent URL-safety history, so he is the best available owner for deciding the public trust boundary.
